high_level_description: This image captures a vibrant scene of a clear blue sky with a prominent rainbow arching across it. The rainbow is vivid and well-defined, with distinct bands of color including red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and purple. The sky is mostly clear, with only a few wispy clouds scattered around the edges of the rainbow. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small text overlay that reads "AMSTERDAM, NETHERLANDS," indicating the location where the photo was taken.
